message.reasoning_content: I'm Blindnak, cash 0, no goods. Shuttle gives 3 goods (grey). Produce gives 2 goods. Price declining. With cash 0, shuttle gives more goods to sell later. Confiscation risk by president (GreedA0 is president). Customs decision — president may set tight. Shuttle gives 3 goods vs produce 2. Risk worth it? President is greedy agent; loose gives him tribute, tight confiscates. Uncertain. Produce is safe: 2 goods at price ~6-7 = 12-14M. Shuttle: 3 goods, maybe confiscated. I'll take shuttle for extra good — actually with 0 cash, confiscation would be devastating. Go safe: produce.
